scope: Replace reply-associated media-analysis authorization with an opaque, hash-only, one-time media action ticket contract for the existing zhongshu -> OpenClaw Core Feishu Binding -> video-factory route.
frozen_and_preserved: OpenClaw Device Auth and Device Pairing
Reply association, card.action.trigger, synthetic-card commands, inbound_claim, and native slash-command registration
prohibited_actions: Binding, Agent, Cron, OAuth, Runtime, or model change
real Feishu message, attachment, or analyzer invocation
device pairing or Gateway service repair
acceptance: image, audio, and video quarantine receipts issue a 128-bit-or-stronger opaque ticket; TXT does not
server state retains only the ticket hash and binds the ticket to exactly one chat, uploader, attachment, receipt, stored copy, SHA-256, media kind, action, TTL, and state
only strict /vf image|audio|video <ticket> commands reach deterministic validation
failed validation never invokes an Analyzer
consumption is atomic and analysis requests are idempotent
receipt ingress facts remain immutable except approved completion fields
Python, Pester, schema, pip, diff, and scoped secret verification are recorded
real R3-R5 remain pending user-driven events
rollback: Offline code and report changes only. No runtime/configuration action is taken; reverting the scoped files restores the prior reply-associated implementation.
secrets: Do not read, emit, or persist credentials, chat IDs, sender IDs, raw inbound paths, file keys, or media contents in reports.
